subject: How a unit takes damage and dies: the six mission Lua bindings AddDamage/Kill/Sink/SetInvincible/IsInvincible/ExplodeToParts, the entity health pair at +36Ch/+370h, the invincibility floor at +150h, and the two pending queues that end in the on-killed dispatch at 0092751F.

headline.was: No document covered how a unit takes damage or dies; the on-killed slot 00CE6290+80h (00928C80) had no known dispatcher.
headline.is: Health is the float pair max +36Ch / current +370h on the entity. Damage flows AddDamage binding 0088E000 -> vtable +1ACh (unit 0095DA00) -> 0087D730 -> 00879070 (the rule) -> 00877B90 (the clamped setter) -> vtable +1B0h (ship 00827A90) -> 00958A30, which calls vtable +70h (Destroy) when a root unit's health reaches 0. Destroy 00926C80 queues the entity on the std::list at 00F899A8 and Kill 00926D90 queues it on the one at 00F899B4; BSP_EntityEventQueues_FlushPending 009273A0 drains the first through vtable +74h and the second through vtable +80h at 0092751F, which is the only on-killed dispatch.
headline.evidence: 0087626 0 is float GetHealthFraction = [this+370h]/[this+36Ch], RET 0, and is 00CFC3D0+110h. 00958DB7-00958DBE: MOV EAX,[ESI] / MOV EDX,[EAX+70h] / PUSH 1 / CALL EDX on the [ESI+71Ch]==0 branch. 00927515-0092751F: MOV EDX,[ESI] / MOV EAX,[EDX+80h] / MOV ECX,ESI / CALL EAX, inside body 009273A0-009275D1, over the container built from 00F899B4 at 009273E4.

corrections.is: +60h is the entity's destroyed flag: 00926C80 returns at once when it is already 1, sets it to 1, and only then fills +70h and recurses. +5Fh is the matching killed flag set by 00926D90. Neither name is changed here; the header constant keeps its name and this report records the meaning.
corrections.evidence: 00926C80 decompiles to `if (*(char *)(param_1 + 0x60) == '\0') { *(undefined1 *)(param_1 + 0x60) = 1; ... }`; 00926D90 to the same shape on +5Fh.

death_sequence.what: 00879070 computes current - amount and calls the setter
00877B90 calls vtable+1B0h unless the session mode is 2
00958A30 sees +71Ch == 0 and health <= 0 and calls vtable+70h with 1
0077D1A0 broadcasts the destroy message and calls the base Destroy
00926C80 sets +60h, fills +70h, recurses over the children and queues the entity on 00F899A8
back in 00827A90, the death session message (id 9Ah, or the breakup message) goes out on channel 7
on a later frame BSP_EntityEventQueues_FlushPending dispatches vtable+74h for every queued destroy
the same flush dispatches vtable+80h (on-killed) for every entity that Kill queued on 00F899B4

open_questions: Who writes +36Ch (maximum health) at spawn. No writer was found in this packet, so the ceiling's producer is unread.

Whether the damage-death path ever reaches vtable+80h. It calls Destroy, which queues on 00F899A8 and dispatches vtable+74h; only 00926D90 (the Lua Kill binding and the two group kills) queues on 00F899B4, which is the list the on-killed dispatch at 0092751F walks.
The Lua self table's Dead field still has no writer. 00928C80 sets Ptr to lightuserdata(0) and LastPosition and does not touch Dead; nothing on the destroy path does either.
The pivot vector 00891B20 computes for Sink is passed to 008110F0 and never read: the body is 85 bytes, RET 4, and no instruction touches [ESP+8].
AddDamage has no type, source or part argument. The binding reads exactly two Lua arguments and 0095DA00 is __thiscall(this, float), RET 4, so there is no armour or part model on this path.
0077D1A0's message id 4Eh and the two senders 0077C7B0 / 0077C980 were not followed.
00958A30's subobject branch (00958A58-00958DA6) drives the per-part destruction sequence through vtable+1B4h, +19Ch and +204h and was only summarised.
run_time_evidence: none. The damage path is not reached by the frames the bsp_game.exe harness runs (no mission is loaded), so no run log supports these claims; every claim above is from the live listing.
build: scripts/build.ps1, Win32 MSVC, warnings as errors
